ORVR VENT VALVE MODULE CHECK 
1. Blow air through over vent valve module nipple (A). Check 
that the air flows out of nipple (B) and nipple (C).
2. Connect a hand vacuum pump to nipple (A) of the over vent 
valve module.
3. With air flow through nipple (C) obstructed, apply a vacuum 
and check that the vacuum is maintained.
